rows.q: Draw a pneumatic circuit: pressing a push button makes a double-acting cylinder extend, and the cylinder returns by itself when it reaches the end of its stroke.
rows.why: nothing returns the cylinder at the end of its stroke (a roller valve it trips when fully out, signalling its valve back)
rows.reply:
MAKE PNEUMATIC: Button extend, auto-return cylinder
cylinder C1 double "extend and retract"
valve V1 C1 5/2 button
flow F1 C1 retract
END
rows.first:
MAKE PNEUMATIC: Button extend, auto-return cylinder
cylinder C1 double "extend and retract"
valve V1 C1 5/2 button
flow F1 C1 retract
END
